notes.title: BrightSeeker Beta Test + Demo Update
notes.content:
[strike][b]BRIGHTSEEKER BETA[/b]
The development of BrightSeeker is slowly coming to an end and with that I would like to announce a final Beta test, which you can join by filling out this form: 

You will get access to the full game in exchange for sending me feedback and your thoughts on the game. Thank you so much, if you decide to participate! I'll be sending out all the beta keys at once, so don't worry if you don't get an e-mail from me right away, it may take a few days.[/strike]

[b]THE BETA IS CLOSED NOW, THANKS EVERYONE WHO PARTICIPATED![/b]

[b]DEMO UPDATE[/b]
v0.1.0.2.

New difficulty settings:
[list]
[*] [b]Teleport Limiter[/b]
Extensive use of the Teleport/Dash ability will cause SPARK to decrease
[*] [b]Mines[/b]
Enemies may spawn mines where they died
[*] [b]Scalable Enemies[/b]
Enemy health increases as the player gets stronger
[/list]
Other changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where melee attack wouldn't reset if player had 0 SPARK
[*] Added diagonal teleport for keyboard
[*] New Player Health icon
[*] Added option to delete save slots
[*] Important breakable objects are targetable with controller (like enemies)
[*] Split Voice and SFX volume
[*] Added Gamma Settings
[*] Hints show correct keys when they are rebinded
[/list]

notes.title: Demo v0.0.1.6 Patch
notes.content:
v0.0.1.6 changes:
[list]
[*] Increased player movement speed, acceleration and deceleration for more responsive gameplay
[*] Slightly increased teleport cooldown
[*] Increased shield deflect time to 0.5s (from 0.25s)
[*] Changed colour of the particles indicating that ranged enemy will attack to make it more readable
[*] Health pickups won't fly towards the player if they have full health
[*] Added new difficulty setting "Retreat Protocol" that allows ranged enemies to teleport away from player if they get too close to them
[*] (hopefully) Fixed the bug where Gameplay settings wouldn't save across levels
[*] "Use Isometric north" setting should work for keyboard as well
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who submitted feedback on the game! I really appreciate it :)
Also, HUGE thanks to everyone who wishlisted the game during the Next Fest, BrightSeeker gained over 2500 wishlists during the festival, which is so much more than what I was hoping for!

notes.title: Feature Breakdown #05 - The Difficulty
notes.content:
Hello there! Welcome to the fifth Breakdown of BrightSeeker's mechanics! This time we're going to look at how you can adjust difficulty to suit your playstyle.

In BrightSeeker there is no easy/hard difficulty, instead there are several Difficulty Settings which you can toggle to make the game easier or harder. For example, you may choose to disable advanced AI behavior to make enemies easier to defeat or if you find the game too easy, you can (among other things) lower your base health or enable special abilities for bosses.

Right now there are seven unique settings, which you can choose from. There may be more added in the future. You may play with just one of them or all of them at once, it's up to you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273766/2dc543698624e6b92175f0c8a95efd880b4b3073.gif[/img]


[h3]Now, let's take a look at what each of them does![/h3]

[b]SECRET ENEMY[/b]
Hides enemy health icons, so you can't precisely know how much health has the enemy left.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273766/bd6b44c6f448ef5f3e9b9f9d1452d8d33d8b8403.gif[/img]

[b]DODGY ENEMIES[/b]
Enemies can dodge incoming projectiles (sometimes).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273766/40f638c946f57009c5d7759a005f1a918189d777.gif[/img]

[b]DASHING THREAT[/b]
Melee enemies can dash towards player character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273766/25059d973f31b93145de1c4e6a547b91fab0ab32.gif[/img]

[b]HELPFUL SCRAP[/b]
When enemies die, they can drop healing pickups for the player.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273766/133ef705212b31e0bd3b57275fdc211f86d72f2b.gif[/img]

[b]DANGEROUS BOSSES[/b]
Enables special attacks for the three main bosses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273766/f7ce7baec5594b252618d64020517da9bc78dee8.gif[/img]
[i]Where would be the fun in showing you what this does? You will have to play the game and find out for yourself :)[/i]

[b]HEALING TOTEM[/b]
Some enemies may spawn a hostile healing totem when they die. This totem will heal all enemies in radius after a short countdown. If it is destroyed by player before it counts down to zero, it heals the player instead.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273766/a4a3bd485a52e29743db0681a1e32b740c76a441.gif[/img]

[b]LIVIN' ON THE EDGE[/b]
Lowers the default player max health. In other words, player has lower maximum health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273766/a12f2d5a2a78110e14b6c6ff6f18674ed66fa943.gif[/img]


You will be able to adjust all the Difficulty Settings when you start a new game or at any time during the game in settings menu.

If you have suggestions for other Difficulty Settings, feel free to leave them in the comments. I'll do my best to include them in the game!

Next month there probably won't be a Feature Breakdown, instead you can look forward to a new updated Demo, which will be available on Steam during (and possibly after) the upcoming Steam Next Fest. Stay tuned for more info about that! Stay safe, bye!

notes.title: New early version available!
notes.content:
I'm super excited to announce that new early build of BrightSeeker is live NOW! 
Join our discord server to play it for FREE!
[url=https://discord.gg/X5N9wghrS4]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273766/3f869c0f2d35569ac0f5aa6d72aa9ed09817c613.png[/img]
https://discord.gg/X5N9wghrS4[/url]
Or sing-up here: [url=http://www.zakroutil.com/join]http://www.zakroutil.com/join[/url]

In this build I focused on making the combat feel smoother and made some changes to the level order for better pacing. (among other things)

Here's the list of all the changes: 

[b]v0.0.0.9 Changes:[/b]
    - Reduced teleport cooldown from 1.3 to 1.0s 
    - Changed ranged attack animation speed + projectiles spawn almost instantly after the animation 
       begins
    - Added particles to staff when firing projectile
    - Items in shop can be purchased only once (except for refills)
    - Added purchasable mod slot to the shop
    - Added Location names
    - Made some adjustments to range attack SFX
    - Increased player projectile speed
    - Added Key mapping
    - Settings are accessible from main menu
    - Changed map order
    - New secret thing in the "Harbour" map

notes.title: New Early build available for ALL Discord Members!
notes.content:
Join our discord server and gain access to all early versions of BrightSeeker for Free!

[url=https://discord.gg/X5N9wghrS4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273766/3f869c0f2d35569ac0f5aa6d72aa9ed09817c613.png[/img][/url]
https://discord.gg/X5N9wghrS4

[b]v0.0.0.8 Changes:[/b]
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug - Trap projectiles colliding with the trap
[*] Fixed animation bug when exiting the "staff/sword" dialogue using keyboard/gamepad shortcut instead of dialogue buttons
[*] Fixed the "Ability Station" bug - Giving player infinite spark/health
[*] Fixed bug - ESC menu opening when closing other UI elements
[*] Fixed spawn location of particles when breaking boxes
[*] Fixed bug when player gets stuck in the first combat area in the first level
[*] Added invisible wall preventing skipping the "Pink Tree" combat sequence
[/list]
New features and tweaks:
[list]
[*] Removed the "Pink Tree" cutscene - replaced with 2D image sequence
[*] More delay before Heavy-mech attacks/teleports
[*] Reworked Shop UI + Added option to refill missing HP/Spark in the Shop
[*] Several tweaks to widget navigation with gamepad
[*] Map "God's Final Rest" updated with new models
[*] Bushes are now breakable objects
[*] Added tutorial when first coin is acquired
[*] Added tutorial when first special ability is acquired
[*] Player character is now rotated to cursor by default (can be turned off in settings)
[*] Add "Reload from checkpoint" button to ESC menu
[*]  When playing with gamepad - targeted enemies will be highlighted before player fires projectile at them
[*] Updated models and UI for some intractable stations
[*] New Main menu
[*] Added audio volume settings and option to enable/disable VSync
[*] Added Async loading screen
[*] F8 opens feedback form
[/list]
